scope: Four normal timing cohorts only: mesh-isolated, final CAD, incremental assumptions, and controls. No timing workload was executed by this audit; GC-instrumented evidence is outside this report.
method: Reviewed harness serialization/control flow; independently parsed every raw report and summary, recomputed all available sample percentiles, validated exact paired work and fixture contracts, checked complete alternating run sequence and recorded timestamps, compared source/harness/dependency/lock bytes, and recomputed every summary row and per-pair change. The project summarizer was not imported. The separately implemented incremental auditor was also run in memory.

headline_claims.claim: Final plate AOT typical execution time improved about 20-22%, with median process p95 improving about 24-29%.
headline_claims.qualification: Profile-edit p95 improved in two process pairs and worsened 3.25% in the third; these are medians of three per-process percentiles.

headline_claims.claim: Isolated mesh allocation change has AOT plate cold/profile p95 regressions, despite median improvements.
headline_claims.qualification: Cold/profile p95 regressions are approximately 38.15% and 9.20% in aggregate, each with two worse pairs and one better pair. Full-final CAD cannot be used to claim these isolated tails improved.

headline_claims.claim: Final retained-angle p95 worsened in all three process pairs in both JIT and AOT.
Million-value compact-range AOT assumption batches improved p50 by more than 99.9%.
headline_claims.qualification: These are complete eight-operation batches, not per-assumption timings; baseline construction/posting enumerated the compact domain.

headline_claims.claim: Explicit-100 JIT assumption control p50 regressed approximately 5-10%.
Transactional AOT control cold/warm p50 regressed about 7.3% and 4.4%, both in all three pairs.

reporting_observations.resolution: Supplied CAD audits now describe raw-sample and aligned-work availability using the actual cohort counts. Recorded dependency-lock and library-tree checks were added to the CAD auditor. Their regenerated results retain the same measurement counts and findings status.

limitations: Recorded sequential timestamps and command identities were reconciled. Saved JSON alone cannot independently prove process isolation, scheduler behavior, or whether unrelated work occurred on the shared unpinned host.
There are three fresh process reports per revision/runtime/harness. Aggregate figures are medians of per-process percentiles, not pooled sample percentiles or statistical confidence intervals.

For cad and cad_linkage, each process has 300 timed samples after 30 warmups; the harness p50 is the upper middle sample (index 150), not the arithmetic average of the two central samples. Its p95 and cad p99 use nearest rank. The incremental harness uses the ordinary median and nearest-rank p95 with 51 samples after 10 warmups.

Most controls expose 25 samples after five warmups. Their p95 is sensitive to a small number of slow samples. cad_instances exposes only p50/p95 from 40 samples; its 24 process distributions cannot be rederived from absent raw samples.

Geometry nonlinear/coupled and CAD workspace control counters describe the last measured result; cad_instances exposes only a final rebuild list. They do not establish per-sample work alignment. CAD plate/linkage and incremental assumptions expose and match every aligned work record.

Independent physical-check pass markers and reviewed harness control flow were checked; reports do not serialize complete solution coordinates or CAD topology, so physical solutions were not independently replayed from JSON.
Large incremental improvements apply to these complete eight-operation assumption/solve batches on one-variable fixtures. They do not establish a universal solver speedup.
The validated/current library-tree identity is verified, but this audit did not rerun native/JavaScript/WebAssembly or browser gates.

Shared-host variance and correctness changes can affect final-versus-baseline timing. The isolated mesh cohort supports attribution for its kernel change; the complete-final cohort does not isolate every correctness change.

refresh.reason: Refresh corrected supplied audit prose/provenance checks and lossless controls raw compression; no timing or source changes.
